# Vue (vendored)

- Version: 2.7.16 (full build, including the template compiler)
- Source: https://github.com/vuejs/vue
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE`)
- Usage: shows and hides dependent fields on the settings and import screens
  (`cooked-vue` handle, admin).

`vue.js` is the minified production build, not the development build, so
`SCRIPT_DEBUG` does not give Vue's development warnings.

Vue 2 reached end of life on 2023-12-31. It is to be removed in the admin UI
redesign; do not build new features on it.
